Submitted (status locked as **deviation**, preferred level, all official checks `ok:true`).

Final proposal:
1. **28.1** — governing law changed to "the laws of the State of New York" with the conflicting Singapore forum words deleted (28.2 already supplies the forum).
2. **28.2** — the offending "in those courts" phrasing was replaced; the injunctive-relief carve-out now reads "in the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York", which the deterministic corresponding-pair check requires while keeping the sentence otherwise byte-for-byte intact.

Element coverage: New York law by operation 1; exclusive state and federal jurisdiction in New York County already met verbatim in 28.2.
